$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: An agent
description: A session at work, as the engine sees it. The brief form (id, title, app, project, branch) names an agent in messages and answers; the agents list and peers send the whole view; the console's snapshot sends the brief form with status, focus, claims, reachability and how many files it's editing.

id.description: An agent: claude:<session id> or codex:<thread id>, or an actor, actor:<slug>

projectId.description: The map node it lives in

repo.description: Its repo's shared git folder, the same for every worktree

reader.description: Read from its own records by an experimental reader (core/native), so no message reaches it

editing.description: Files it edited in the last half hour; the console's snapshot sends how many

observed.description: An actor's edit XenoNet inferred from what it observes; the actor didn't report it

pattern.description: An absolute path, a folder (ending in /) or a glob

items.description: A claim, as an agent's claims list it

reachable.description: In touch directly lately, so messages reach it

overlap.description: From peers: files you've both edited lately

delivery.description: From send: when it will see the message

host.description: In a XenoNet network, the host an agent on another machine is on; its id is @<host>:<id>

seen.description: For an agent on another host: when that host was last heard from

online.description: For an agent on another host: whether its host's link is up; offline since seen when it isn't

repoKey.description: For an agent on another host: the normalized git remote of its folder, which clones of one repo share

waitsOnYou.description: For an agent on another host: a question or a stuck state waits on the person
